zh-CN.title: 媒体预览操作优化
items: 拍摄信息随拖动渐显，向下收起后可继续浏览，再下滑才退出。
缩略条更容易拖动，已加载的缩略图可复用。点击顶部发送者信息可跳回原消息。

en.title: Media viewer refinements
items: Photo details fade in as you drag. Swipe down to collapse the details, then swipe again to close the viewer.
The thumbnail strip is easier to scrub and reuses loaded thumbnails. Tap the sender at the top to jump to the original message.
